text.description_html:
RK International CP-54, Two-Toned Rod Cabinet Pull

The Contemporary Two Toned Cabinet Door Pull made by RK International is sure to add a beautiful, modern statement to any home. It is available in two finish combinations: satin nickel with polished brass and oil rubbed bronze with polished brass (click picture to right to see both). Both these choices have a modern feel. Available in 2 sizes, a 3 inch center to center and a 3-1/2 inch center to center.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-54 Plain Rod Cabinet Pulls:

  • Material: Brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    RKI-CP-54
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
    • Overall Length: 4"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"

    RKI-CP-55
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-1/2"
    • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"

Sold Individually
